Class RexxAndJava.RAJBean

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.rexxla.bsf.engines.rexx.RexxAndJava.RAJBean
  • Enclosing class:
    RexxAndJava

    public static class RexxAndJava.RAJBean
extends java.lang.Object
    This class maintains the name, the Java object denoted by it and the reference count of the Java object. The name will be used as the key.
